legal_units.title: False statement in verification, etc.
legal_units.text: If a person makes a statement in any verification under this Act or under any rule made thereunder, or delivers an account or statement which is false, and which he either knows or believes to be false, or does not believe to be true, he shall be punishable,— statement or account had been accepted as true, exceeds fifty lakh rupees; or
